The re-audit is complete. Summary:

**Independently re-verified all 5 PRs as COMPLETE** — projexa #52 (header fix), #54 (PWA/offline sync), #56 (role gating), and compliance-tracker #596 (BoQ/valuation), #597 (timesheet report). All three mandated deep re-checks passed with hard evidence (real tests exercising the actual race/isolation conditions, not superficial checks):
- PR #54's offline queue is genuinely per-user-scoped with a real mutex (verified via a race-condition test)
- PR #56's role-gating sweep covered all PATCH/DELETE endpoints — found one adjacent, pre-existing, out-of-scope gap (`access-review/certifications/[id]` lacks a role gate) worth a follow-up task, but it's not part of PR #56's own diff
- PR #596's interim bills produce real nonzero tax and retention correctly doesn't reduce the taxable subtotal

`tsc` clean and tests green in both repos (I independently re-ran the compliance-tracker checks myself rather than trusting sub-agent output alone — numbers matched exactly). Report written to `ai-os/audits/projexa_erp_e2e_reaudit_2026-07-27.md`, PR opened: **https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/603**

One thing worth flagging: partway through I caught myself having accidentally clobbered pre-existing PROGRESS.md content from two other already-merged tasks (this repo concatenates PROGRESS sections across merges) — I restored it and appended my section instead, in a follow-up commit, before opening the PR.
